answer: Trust transfers at one exact timestamp: the block where a new agent burns a locked bond and its soulbound attestation is minted. The transfer cannot repeat — the burn consumes a unique outpoint, and replaying it is a double-spend consensus rejects. So while a nebula of fake names is cheap to spray, each sprout in the meadow needs its own burned coin, and caught liars sink to nadir with stake slashed. One burn, one identity, no rebirth.
